Welcome to Bandhan

About Bandhan

A rishta is not found by chance — it is found with care. Bandhan is a matrimonial platform built for families who want honesty, privacy and profiles they can truly trust.

One platform, one purpose — the right rishta.

Every profile on Bandhan carries a complete biodata and a clear photo, so families can decide with confidence before the first conversation even begins. No endless swiping, no guesswork — just genuine brides and grooms who are here for marriage.

Pick a package that matches how you want to search. A free profile lets you explore, while our paid plans unlock photos, full biodata, contact details and the ability to send interests directly.

  • ✓Verified profiles — mobile and ID checked members carry the verified badge.
  • ✓Full biodata with photo — age, education, profession, family and expectations, all in one place.
  • ✓Your privacy, your rules — your contact details are visible only to members on the plans you allow.

Simple and safe

How It Works

From your first visit to your wedding day — Bandhan works in three simple steps.

1

Create Your Profile

Register free in two minutes. Add your photo and complete biodata — education, profession, family and the partner you are looking for.

2

Choose a Package

Every package unlocks a different level of access. Pick the one that fits you — see more profiles, view photos and biodata, or connect directly.

3

Find Your Match

Browse brides and grooms, shortlist the profiles you like, send an interest, and when both families say yes — your Bandhan begins.

A Bandhan story

Aarav & Ananya — Jaipur

Ananya's family viewed Aarav's profile on a Gold plan and sent the first interest. One phone call became a meeting over chai, the meeting became a roka, and in February they married at a palace lawn in Jaipur — with both families saying the biodata told them everything they needed to know.

“We did not meet by accident. We met because the right profile reached the right family at the right time.”
